value.name: Asha arrives to inspect the house
value.description: In the week after Inez's funeral, Asha enters the Serrano row house with probate concerns already on her mind.
evidence: The week after the funeral, the Serrano row house held its breath
Asha had set her bag down in the library before she'd even taken off her coat; the probate calendar in her head was loud enough that small talk felt like a waste of air.

value.name: Asha searches Inez's favored shelves
value.description: Asha begins methodically searching the library shelves Inez was known to favor, checking hidden spaces behind books and furniture.
evidence: She started with the shelves Inez was known to favor, lifting books in pairs and checking behind the leather Audubons, then knelt to test the underside of the partner's desk for a drawer that didn't match the others.

value.name: Rosa quietly polishes the sideboard
value.description: From the dining room, Rosa hums and carefully polishes the mahogany sideboard, focusing on a suspicious seam in the wood.
evidence: From the dining room came the soft, deliberate sound of Rosa humming, a tune Asha half-recognized from the wake, and the careful drag of a cloth across the mahogany sideboard.
When Asha looked up, Rosa was bent close to the lower panel, polishing a seam in the wood that wouldn't have needed polishing if it had only ever been a seam.

value.name: Asha notices Rosa's suspicious behavior
value.description: Asha silently registers Rosa's hand angle and chooses not to interrupt, letting Rosa continue working.
evidence: Neither of them said anything about it, but Asha registered the angle of Rosa's hand and stayed where she was, letting the woman work.

value.name: Asha approaches Rosa for access
value.description: Asha crosses into the dining room and politely asks Rosa to show her the part that needs the most work.
evidence: Asha rose from the partner's desk and crossed into the dining room without hurry, stopping at a polite distance from the sideboard so Rosa could choose whether to look up.
"Will you show me which part needs the most work?" she asked, keeping her voice low enough that the question sounded like ordinary curiosity.

value.name: Rosa silently reveals a hidden seam
value.description: Rosa stops humming and, without answering, intensifies her polishing on a recessed bead in the sideboard, implying a concealed feature.
